summary: Scinai Immunotherapeutics filed a Form 6-K on August 19, 2026, announcing an ADS ratio change effective August 21, 2026, from 1 ADS representing 4,000 ordinary shares to 1 ADS representing 40,000 ordinary shares, equivalent to a one-for-ten reverse split. The reverse split aims to raise the per-ADS trading price above $1.00 to regain compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). No action is required from ADS holders; fractional entitlements will be aggregated and sold, with net proceeds distributed. The ticker remains SCNI, with a new CUSIP number. There is no assurance of regaining compliance, leaving a risk of potential delisting if the price fails to sustain the minimum bid requirement.
